entries.name: Comet
entries.prerequisites: Free the Cornerstone of Light. Equip Fantasia (3 AP).
entries.instructions: Use the Limit command with the required party member active and Sora outside Drive Forms. Finish the command sequence to register the entry: Comet → Comet Rain. Party Limits consume Sora’s remaining MP; Trinity uses Donald and Goofy for its full sequence.

entries.name: Duck Flare
entries.prerequisites: Defeat the Grim Reaper at the Harbor on the second Port Royal visit. Equip Flare Force (3 AP).
entries.instructions: Use the Limit command with the required party member active and Sora outside Drive Forms. Finish the command sequence to register the entry: Duck Flare → Rocket Flare → Megaduck Flare. Party Limits consume Sora’s remaining MP; Trinity uses Donald and Goofy for its full sequence.

entries.name: Whirli-Goof
entries.prerequisites: Defeat Storm Rider. Equip Tornado Fusion (3 AP).
entries.instructions: Use the Limit command with the required party member active and Sora outside Drive Forms. Finish the command sequence to register the entry: Whirli-Goof → Whirli-Goofra → Whirli-Goofga. Party Limits consume Sora’s remaining MP; Trinity uses Donald and Goofy for its full sequence.

entries.name: Knocksmash
entries.prerequisites: Defeat Barbossa. Equip Teamwork (3 AP).
entries.instructions: Use the Limit command with the required party member active and Sora outside Drive Forms. Finish the command sequence to register the entry: Knocksmash → Duo Raid → Cosmo Boost. Party Limits consume Sora’s remaining MP; Trinity uses Donald and Goofy for its full sequence.

entries.instructions: Use the Limit command with the required party member active and Sora outside Drive Forms. entries.name: Never Land
entries.prerequisites: Feather Charm.
entries.instructions: Summon Peter Pan, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Tiny Fairy / The Flying Boy → Journey’s End. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: FPS Mode
entries.prerequisites: Baseball Charm.
entries.instructions: Summon Chicken Little, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Balls / Firecrackers. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Ohana!

entries.instructions: Summon Stitch, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Shoot / Ukulele → Blast. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Sonic Rave
entries.prerequisites: Lamp Charm and Valor Form.
entries.instructions: Summon Genie and select the matching Genie form, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Sonic → Rave. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Strike Raid
entries.prerequisites: Lamp Charm and Wisdom Form.
entries.instructions: Summon Genie and select the matching Genie form, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Strike → Judgement. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Final Arcana
entries.prerequisites: Lamp Charm and Master Form.
entries.instructions: Summon Genie and select the matching Genie form, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Arcana → Bash. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Infinity
entries.prerequisites: Lamp Charm and Final Form.
entries.instructions: Summon Genie and select the matching Genie form, then use this Limit and complete its sequence: Infinity → Impact. It spends Summon Gauge instead of MP. The four Limit Form attacks are not Journal Limit entries.

entries.name: Sephiroth
entries.summary: Optional battle; Fenrir requires a separate follow-up.
entries.prerequisites: Complete the Battle of the 1000 Heartless.
entries.reward: Drive Gauge +1; Cloud follow-up unlocks Fenrir
entries.instructions: Defeat Sephiroth, talk to Cloud at the Marketplace, then return to Dark Depths and talk to Sephiroth. After the scene Tifa gives Fenrir. Use the Block reaction command for the opening attack and interrupt Heartless Angel before it completes.

entries.name: Lingering Will
entries.summary: Optional battle; first victory and rematches have different rewards.
entries.prerequisites: Complete every world’s story, including Atlantica and 100 Acre Wood, defeat the final boss and load the clear save.
entries.reward: First victory: Proof of Connection and stat rewards. Rematches: Manifest Illusion.
entries.instructions: Examine the portal to the Badlands. Claim Proof of Connection on the first victory; revisit the portal for repeatable Manifest Illusion. Keep the Proof of Peace and Proof of Nonexistence receipts separate for the crown.

entries.name: Moogle levels
entries.instructions: Level 2 enables Bright/Energy; level 3 enables Serenity upgrades in Creations; level 4 allows two modifier types. Cost reductions: C at level 5, B at 6, A at 7, S at 9. Level 8 unlocks advanced Free Development. Bright uses one matching-rank material and doubles recipe EXP.

entries.name: Swim This Way
entries.summary: Journal goal: perform this song again after the first clear.
entries.prerequisites: Clear Sebastian’s introductory tutorial.
entries.instructions: Talk to Sebastian. Clear objective: Finish with at least one note. Replay it for the Journal mission; rewards are awarded only on the first clear.

entries.name: Part of Your World
entries.summary: Journal goal: perform this song again after the first clear.
entries.prerequisites: Clear Swim This Way and obtain Magnet.
entries.instructions: Talk to Flounder to move the statue. Clear objective: Get five consecutive Excellent ratings. Replay it for the Journal mission; rewards are awarded only on the first clear.

entries.name: Under the Sea
entries.summary: Journal goal: perform this song again after the first clear.
entries.prerequisites: Clear Part of Your World and raise maximum Drive Gauge to five.
entries.instructions: Talk to Sebastian; respond to Ariel prompts and ignore Sebastian prompts. Clear objective: Finish with Ariel’s gauge in the top section. Replay it for the Journal mission; rewards are awarded only on the first clear.

entries.name: Ursula’s Revenge
entries.summary: Journal goal: perform this song again after the first clear.
entries.prerequisites: Clear Under the Sea and obtain Magnera.
entries.instructions: Talk to Ariel, then Sebastian; follow timed and rapid-input prompts. Clear objective: Defeat Ursula before the song ends. Replay it for the Journal mission; rewards are awarded only on the first clear.

entries.name: A New Day is Dawning
entries.summary: Journal goal: perform this song again after the first clear.
entries.prerequisites: Clear Ursula’s Revenge and obtain Thundaga.
entries.reward: First clear: Blizzard element upgrade and Orichalcum+.
entries.instructions: Talk to Sebastian; this combines the earlier prompt types. Clear objective: Score at least 30,000. Replay it for the Journal mission; rewards are awarded only on the first clear.

entries.name: Chasm of Challenges
entries.area: The Cave of Wonders: Chasm of Challenges
entries.instructions: Revisit the challenge after opening the Treasure Room during the first visit. Defeat the enemies on all five descending floors within two minutes. The Journal asks for a repeat clear, not a separate high score.

entries.name: Cavern of Remembrance traversal
entries.summary: Reach the Replica Data hub and its treasure chests.
entries.instructions: Enter the hole in the Postern after the 1,000-Heartless sequence. Bring level-3 High Jump, Quick Run, Aerial Dodge and Glide as a sufficient traversal loadout. Climb the Depths; cross the first Mineshaft gap with Quick Run. In the Mining Area activate the engines at the bottom, then use the moving machinery to climb. Aerial Dodge through the next Mineshaft pipes, cross the Engine Chamber conveyors, then Glide through the final pipe corridor. Clear all three Nobody wave encounters in Transport to Remembrance to reach the Garden of Assemblage.

kh2fm.achievements.limit-master.instructions: Record all 21 entries in the Journal Limits checklist: 14 party Limits and 7 Summon Limits. Use every Genie form. Limit Form attacks do not count.

kh2fm.achievements.my-hero.instructions: Lose a qualifying story boss fight and choose “I won’t give up!”: Shan-Yu; Thresholder/Possessor; Shadow Stalker/Dark Thorn; Cerberus; Hydra; Blizzard Lord/Volcanic Lord; Storm Rider; Xaldin; first Grim Reaper; first Armored Xemnas. Rescue chances by prior rescue count are 100%, 80%, 64%, then 50%. With Mickey, fill the Drive Gauge using D-Charge and use Healing Light to revive Sora. Mickey cannot deliver the finishing blow.

kh2fm.achievements.navigator.instructions: Complete the 40-entry Maps checklist: 37 original map awards plus three Cavern of Remembrance maps added in Final Mix. Chest aliases retain the original treasure check; direct awards have their own map records.

kh2fm.materials.orichalcum-plus.instructions: Seven finite acquisitions. Chests: Sunset Terrace; Central Computer Mesa; Brink of Despair. Rewards: finish 100 Acre Wood; finish A New Day is Dawning; win Goddess of Fate Cup; deposit all 60 material types at a Moogle. The 60 include Orichalcum+ itself: deposit one from another source first, so the collector reward is not your first Orichalcum+. After receiving the reward, leave and re-enter synthesis to deposit it. No repeatable farm.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-1.appendInstructions: Use Reversal until the mushroom turns away, then strike its back.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-1.prerequisites: Defeat Xemnas and load the clear save.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-2.appendInstructions: Face incoming shots and use Guard or Reflect; Final Form’s floating Keyblades can deflect attacks.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-3.appendInstructions: Stack Draw and follow with Quick Run or Glide; collect prizes before they disappear.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-4.appendInstructions: Circle the square in Wisdom Form while firing; maintain distance from the clones.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-5.appendInstructions: Use Limit Form’s Zantetsuken finishers or Final Form Firaga to overcome its regeneration.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-5.prerequisites: Return outside an active story episode in this world.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-6.appendInstructions: Use Final Form magic: Fire for clusters, Blizzard for rows and Thunder for vertical groups.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-6.prerequisites: Return outside an active story episode in this world.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-7.appendInstructions: Keep away from contact; Reflect or long-range magic avoids its knockback.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-8.appendInstructions: Use Berserk Charge and Horizontal Slash to keep it airborne; remove MP Haste and empty MP first.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-8.prerequisites: Return after Twilight Town’s third visit; take the train from Central Station to The Tower.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-9.appendInstructions: Keep the target spinning with Berserk Charge and Horizontal Slash; remove MP Haste before starting.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-10.appendInstructions: Keep all five mushrooms on screen, follow the original during the shuffle, then attack only that target.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-10.prerequisites: Reach the second Port Royal visit.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-11.appendInstructions: Wisdom Form finishers deliver rapid hits; use Negative Combo and Finishing Plus.
kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-11.prerequisites: Return to the Waterway outside an active Timeless River story episode.

kh2fm.mushrooms.mushroom-xiii-12.appendInstructions: Use Wisdom Form shots and turn the camera between clones, including those above the pillars.

kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-zexio.area: Cave of the Dead: Inner Chamber
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-zexio.instructions: Examine the portal to challenge Zexion. The first victory awards the recipe and Lost Illusion. For repeatable Lost Illusion, use this member’s Replica Data rematch.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-zexio.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Free a captured ally by breaking their book. Inside the book world, identify and damage Zexion’s real book, then use Dispel to escape. When the colored circles shuffle, enter the blue circle before the meteor attack; a long party Limit can protect the group if positioning fails.

kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-larxe.instructions: Examine the portal to challenge Larxene. The first victory awards the recipe and Lost Illusion. For repeatable Lost Illusion, use this member’s Replica Data rematch.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-larxe.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Avoid Thunder because Larxene absorbs it. Guard or Reflect the rushing copies; a finisher can open Merge to remove a clone and stun her. Her clones share HP, so attacks that hit several copies can deal extra damage. Use lightning-resistant armor and preserve healing for her late lightning barrage.

kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-lexae.prerequisites: Defeat the second-visit Nobodies. During the next Twilight Town visit the portal returns only after clearing that visit.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-lexae.instructions: Examine the portal to challenge Lexaeus. The first victory awards the recipe and Lost Illusion. For repeatable Lost Illusion, use this member’s Replica Data rematch.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-lexae.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Guard or Reflect the low weapon sweep, then use Mega Impact to stun Lexaeus and create a damage opening. Watch the delayed third ground slam. When he charges from outside the arena, block the charge and use Reflect or stay airborne to avoid the erupting rocks.

kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-vexen.prerequisites: Reach the remodeled shop on the second visit.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-vexen.instructions: Examine the portal to challenge Vexen. The first victory awards the recipe and Lost Illusion. For repeatable Lost Illusion, use this member’s Replica Data rematch.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-vexen.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Break the shield before attacking Vexen. Keep moving out of the tracking data circle so Anti-Sora does not grow stronger; eliminate the clone if it interrupts your attacks. Use Fire against Vexen after his shield breaks, and save MP for defense during his ice attacks.

kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-marlu.prerequisites: Reach the expulsion scene on the second visit.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-marlu.instructions: Examine the portal to challenge Marluxia. The first victory awards the recipe and Lost Illusion. For repeatable Lost Illusion, use this member’s Replica Data rematch.
kh2fm.challenges.absent-silhouette-marlu.appendInstructions: Battle approach: The death counter starts at Sora’s level and scythe hits reduce it independently of HP. Block his combo and punish the recovery. After blocking Tornado Slash, use Restore Count near the scythe to recover counter points, or Aerial Strike near Marluxia for damage. Keep clear of the dark floor pools.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xemnas.prerequisites: Defeat Xemnas for the final time in the story. Defeat the final boss and load the clear save; The World That Never Was Data fights are unavailable before a game clear. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xemnas.appendInstructions: Battle approach: This rematch has two consecutive phases; losing the second restarts the first. In the solo phase, guard or Reflect the blade combo and punish its recovery; Facedown’s Finish leaves him at 1 HP, and Thunder cannot finish him. With Riku, follow Reversal prompts; when controlling Riku, use Dark Aura to hold back the clone while approaching Sora for the rescue command. During the final laser sequence, repeatedly use both displayed defend actions, then land a finisher or Limit.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xigbar.prerequisites: Defeat Xigbar for the final time in the story. Defeat the final boss and load the clear save; The World That Never Was Data fights are unavailable before a game clear. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xigbar.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Data Xigbar no longer pauses to reload. Deflect his shots with Guard or Reflect to create an opening for an aerial combo. Use Warp Snipe when its prompt appears, but defend early against his much faster charged blue shot. Keep moving during the small-platform barrage; avoid relying on repeated Reflect for the entire sequence.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xaldin.prerequisites: Defeat Xaldin for the final time in the story. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-xaldin.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Use Learn after defending his spear attacks, then Jump to break through Protective Wind and begin an aerial combo. Ordinary attacks against that wind deal almost no damage. Stay mobile during his leaps and use Reflect against the final landing or wind blast. This rematch provides neither Beast nor Mickey assistance.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-vexen.prerequisites: Defeat Vexen’s Absent Silhouette. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-vexen.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Break the shield before attacking Vexen. Keep moving out of the tracking data circle so Anti-Sora does not grow stronger; eliminate the clone if it interrupts your attacks. Use Fire against Vexen after his shield breaks, and save MP for defense during his ice attacks. His rematch shield requires physical or neutral damage. Apply the shield/data-circle strategy above, and keep your distance when the screen darkens for Icy Ensemble. A long Donald Limit can protect you through the ice sequence; his shield cannot be broken during that attack.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-lexaeus.prerequisites: Defeat Lexaeus’s Absent Silhouette. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-lexaeus.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Guard or Reflect the low weapon sweep, then use Mega Impact to stun Lexaeus and create a damage opening. Watch the delayed third ground slam. When he charges from outside the arena, block the charge and use Reflect or stay airborne to avoid the erupting rocks. He begins with more power and HP than the Silhouette. Continue blocking the sweep for Mega Impact and attack during the resulting stun. After Earthen Fury, take safe openings promptly because prolonged combat lets his power rise further.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-zexion.prerequisites: Defeat Zexion’s Absent Silhouette. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-zexion.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Free a captured ally by breaking their book. Inside the book world, identify and damage Zexion’s real book, then use Dispel to escape. When the colored circles shuffle, enter the blue circle before the meteor attack; a long party Limit can protect the group if positioning fails. The book/Dispel and blue-circle mechanics still apply, with more HP and altered attack ordering. Keep recovery available and use the safe opening after leaving the book world to attack.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-sa-x.prerequisites: Defeat Saïx for the final time in the story. Defeat the final boss and load the clear save; The World That Never Was Data fights are unavailable before a game clear. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-sa-x.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Interrupt his opening charge with a finisher if possible. During Berserk, prioritize avoiding his wide attacks and quickly collect a dropped claymore. Complete Berserk → Eclipse → Magna Storm to empty his Berserk gauge, then guard his normal attacks and punish openings. Dropped weapons disappear faster than in the story battle.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-axel.prerequisites: Defeat Axel for the final time in the story. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-axel.appendInstructions: Battle approach: The burning floor drains HP and prevents the finishing blow. Drive him out of the ring, then follow Burst Frontier → Overtaker → Clear Light to extinguish it. Blizzard and Reflect provide useful damage; Limit Form can restore health while you prepare another safe opening.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-demyx.prerequisites: Defeat Demyx for the final time in the story. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-demyx.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Keep MP-restoring items ready for both sets of timed water clones. Wisdom Form Firaga quickly clears groups; Blizzaga or finishers can turn clones into notes for Wild Dance. The final clone round requires 99 defeats within 30 seconds. Disable Auto-Limit if it interferes with Wild Dance, then punish Demyx between his water attacks.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-luxord.prerequisites: Defeat Luxord for the final time in the story. Defeat the final boss and load the clear save; The World That Never Was Data fights are unavailable before a game clear. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-luxord.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Watch the command menu and win the circle-symbol games to transfer time from Luxord to Sora. Track his face card while it shuffles and avoid bomb cards. Winning the final four-circle game is necessary in the rematch; finish with a combo finisher or magic once his remaining time is nearly gone.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-marluxia.prerequisites: Defeat Marluxia’s Absent Silhouette. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-marluxia.appendInstructions: Battle approach: The death counter starts at Sora’s level and scythe hits reduce it independently of HP. Block his combo and punish the recovery. After blocking Tornado Slash, use Restore Count near the scythe to recover counter points, or Aerial Strike near Marluxia for damage. Keep clear of the dark floor pools. In the rematch, Restore Count returns progressively fewer points: 13, 7, 3, 2, then 1. Defend the death counter instead of depending on repeated restoration. Avoid the flower detonation and floor pools at the opening; attack after a guarded scythe sequence.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-larxene.prerequisites: Defeat Larxene’s Absent Silhouette. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-larxene.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Avoid Thunder because Larxene absorbs it. Guard or Reflect the rushing copies; a finisher can open Merge to remove a clone and stun her. Her clones share HP, so attacks that hit several copies can deal extra damage. Use lightning-resistant armor and preserve healing for her late lightning barrage. Use the same defense, clone and Merge approach as the Silhouette, with extra HP and different attack ordering. Reflect and wide attacks can punish overlapping copies; keep enough resources to survive the late lightning sequence.

kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-roxas.prerequisites: Defeat Roxas for the final time in the story. Defeat the final boss and load the clear save; The World That Never Was Data fights are unavailable before a game clear. Reach the Garden of Assemblage through the Cavern of Remembrance.
kh2fm.challenges.replica-data-roxas.appendInstructions: Battle approach: Guard his opening sweep and the final dash of his combo to create a punish window. Select The End during the duel to steal his Keyblades, then use the brief advantage without extending combos carelessly: he retaliates sooner than in the story fight. Glide around the faster light projectiles and keep a recovery option ready.

kh2fm.materials.bright-shard.appendInstructions: Optional synthesis modifier: add one Bright Shard to a rank C recipe to double its Moogle EXP. Requires Moogle level 2; combining two modifier types requires level 4. Material collection rank: C.

kh2fm.materials.bright-stone.appendInstructions: Optional synthesis modifier: add one Bright Stone to a rank B recipe to double its Moogle EXP. Requires Moogle level 2; combining two modifier types requires level 4. Material collection rank: B.

kh2fm.materials.bright-gem.appendInstructions: Optional synthesis modifier: add one Bright Gem to a rank A recipe to double its Moogle EXP. Requires Moogle level 2; combining two modifier types requires level 4. Material collection rank: A.

kh2fm.materials.bright-crystal.appendInstructions: Optional synthesis modifier: add one Bright Crystal to a rank S recipe to double its Moogle EXP. Requires Moogle level 2; combining two modifier types requires level 4. Material collection rank: S.

kh2fm.materials.serenity-shard.appendInstructions: Material collection rank: C. Reveal locations: Checkpoint — break the explosive cart; The West Hall — break the armor stands; Cave of the Dead: Entrance — break the lamps; Bazaar — break the stalls; Candy Cane Lane — interact with the carousel. A Steam guide reports refreshing the encounters by traveling Bamboo Grove → Checkpoint → Encampment → Checkpoint → Encampment, then visiting the other worlds. If a room has no Vendor, continue the route rather than treating a scenery interaction as a guaranteed spawn.

kh2fm.achievements.craftsman.instructions: Complete all 54 Moogle Collection List goals, including each material family, all four ranks, all 60 types, total-deposit goals, and the 24 purchase unlocks. Visit synthesis to deposit and claim rewards; spending stock does not undo deposited totals.

kh2fm.forms.final-form.prerequisites: Defeat Roxas; have at least five Drive bars and both eligible party members available.
kh2fm.forms.final-form.appendInstructions: Before the first unlock, an Antiform-trigger attempt can become Final Form: Final Mix chances are 3%, 9%, 27%, then 75% on subsequent attempts. Equip Two Become One to force eligible Antiform attempts in battle. After the first Final activation it becomes a menu choice.

kh2fm.keyblades.two-become-one.appendInstructions: Light & Darkness forces eligible in-battle Drive attempts toward Antiform, helping unlock Final Form after Roxas when at least five Drive bars are filled. After Final is unlocked it forces Antiform unless Final itself is selected. It does not override missing/unconscious party members or out-of-combat restrictions.

kh2fm.achievements.corroded-by-darkness.instructions: Enter Antiform thirteen times. Before multipliers its chance is 0% at 0–4 Anti Points, 10% at 5–9, and 25% at 10+. Valor/Wisdom/Limit/Master add 1 point; Final subtracts 10; Antiform subtracts 4; obtaining a Form resets the counter. Two Become One forces eligible Antiform attempts in battle after Final is unlocked. Both allies must be available; Final Form selection never becomes Antiform.

kh2fm.summons.baseball-charm.appendInstructions: Summoning requires three Drive bars and two party members present; knocked-out allies still qualify, except cups that explicitly allow solo summons. All summons share one level: gain 1 EXP whenever the Summon Gauge drops by a whole bar. The level cap is 3, 4, 5, or 7 with one, two, three, or four charms owned. Cumulative EXP for levels 1–7: 0, 6, 22, 47, 89, 152, 250. Attack just after a bar drops to refill it, then earn another EXP when it drops again.

All summons share one level: gain 1 EXP whenever the Summon Gauge drops by a whole bar. The level cap is 3, 4, 5, or 7 with one, two, three, or four charms owned. kh2fm.cups.pain-and-panic.appendInstructions: Drive use is disabled and party Limits cost less MP. Use repeated party Limits for safety; Magnet and Thunder on round 9’s Rapid Thrusters can raise the score.

kh2fm.cups.pain-and-panic-paradox.appendInstructions: Drive use is disabled and party Limits cost less MP. Use repeated party Limits for safety; Magnet and Thunder on round 9’s Rapid Thrusters can raise the score.

kh2fm.cups.cerberus.appendInstructions: Timed solo cup: Forms work without allies and Drive refills faster. Use Forms to clear waves quickly; extra time is awarded after rounds.

kh2fm.cups.cerberus-paradox.appendInstructions: Timed solo cup: Forms work without allies and Drive refills faster. Use Forms to clear waves quickly; extra time is awarded after rounds.

kh2fm.cups.titan.appendInstructions: Solo summons are allowed. Preserve the shared 500 Key Points: damage depletes this nonrefillable allowance. Stitch’s Ohana! Ukulele and Peter Pan’s Journey’s End can generate score before enemies are defeated.

kh2fm.cups.titan-paradox.appendInstructions: Solo summons are allowed. Preserve the shared 500 Key Points: damage depletes this nonrefillable allowance. Stitch’s Ohana! Ukulele and Peter Pan’s Journey’s End can generate score before enemies are defeated.

kh2fm.cups.hades-paradox.appendInstructions: Rules by round block: 1–10 unrestricted; 11–20 solo Summons with 500 damage points; 21–30 party and cheaper Limits with Drive locked; 31–40 solo Forms with fast Drive recharge and a ten-minute timer; 41–50 solo with no Summons and only Limit Form available in Final Mix. Hercules joins in round 50. Gain score with summon Limits in early blocks; round 47 is the last scoring opportunity.

kh2fm.minigames.sb-sand-glider.name: SB Sand Slider
kh2fm.minigames.sb-sand-glider.appendInstructions: Talk to the Peddler. Collect at least ten crystals within 30 seconds.

kh2fm.minigames.mail-delivery.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Deliver to all five recipients; use Grind to reach the elevated dove without backtracking.

kh2fm.minigames.cargo-climb.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Attack the cart from behind, keeping it centered uphill. Follow its launch with an aerial finisher; Negative Combo reduces the setup hits.

kh2fm.minigames.grandstander.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Keep the ball airborne. Berserk Charge during MP recharge suppresses finishers and permits a long string of hits.

kh2fm.minigames.poster-duty.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Plan a loop through clustered poster sites. Use High Jump, Aerial Dodge and Glide between clusters; posting refreshes the aerial-dodge opportunity.

kh2fm.minigames.bumble-buster.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Gather the swarms with Magnet, then use Fire or Thunder to clear them together.

kh2fm.minigames.junk-sweep.appendInstructions: Start at this area’s Help Wanted board. Start from the help-wanted board. Line up debris so one pile hits others; use Negative Combo and remove Combo Plus to reach finishers immediately. The target counts swings, not elapsed time.

kh2fm.minigames.hayner-struggle.prerequisites: Return for Sora’s late Twilight Town visit.
kh2fm.minigames.hayner-struggle.appendInstructions: Use the Struggle organizer to select the opponent. Knock out the opponent’s orbs, then collect them while the opponent is stunned. Draw helps collect scattered orbs; Trinity Limit rapidly stuns the opponent. Hayner’s target is a winning margin of 100; Setzer’s is a final score of 150; Seifer’s is all 200 orbs.

kh2fm.minigames.setzer-struggle.prerequisites: Win ten matches against Hayner as Sora.
kh2fm.minigames.setzer-struggle.appendInstructions: Use the Struggle organizer to select the opponent. Knock out the opponent’s orbs, then collect them while the opponent is stunned. Draw helps collect scattered orbs; Trinity Limit rapidly stuns the opponent. Hayner’s target is a winning margin of 100; Setzer’s is a final score of 150; Seifer’s is all 200 orbs.

kh2fm.minigames.seifer-struggle.prerequisites: Win ten matches against Setzer as Sora.
kh2fm.minigames.seifer-struggle.appendInstructions: Use the Struggle organizer to select the opponent. Knock out the opponent’s orbs, then collect them while the opponent is stunned. Draw helps collect scattered orbs; Trinity Limit rapidly stuns the opponent. Hayner’s target is a winning margin of 100; Setzer’s is a final score of 150; Seifer’s is all 200 orbs.

kh2fm.minigames.sb-street-rave.appendInstructions: Talk to the girl beside Wantz’s Item Shop. Score across five jumps; no timer.

kh2fm.minigames.sb-freestyle.appendInstructions: Talk to Scrooge McDuck. Reach 200 in one continuous trick sequence; touching ground or a wall resets the score.

kh2fm.minigames.phil-s-training-maniac.appendInstructions: Talk to Phil and select Maniac. Break the pots and collect the released points; the Journal requires 1,000 points.

kh2fm.minigames.magic-carpet.appendInstructions: After Agrabah’s second visit, activate the switch. Use finishers against large enemies and knock airborne enemies into Fat Bandits for additional defeats.

kh2fm.minigames.a-blustery-rescue.appendInstructions: After the first Torn Page, replay by talking to Piglet. Break pots and logs, use whirlwinds when many objects are visible, and reclaim Pooh immediately if hit.

kh2fm.minigames.hunny-slider.appendInstructions: After the second Torn Page, talk to Rabbit. Follow the hunny trails, use Gopher as protection, and recover Pooh immediately after a collision.

kh2fm.minigames.balloon-bounce.appendInstructions: Alternate short bounces along a row with a timed high bounce to reach the next row. Reach the highest balloons for the large score bonus.

kh2fm.minigames.the-expotition.appendInstructions: Talk to Kanga. Keep the group close, calm frightened friends, avoid shining ice, and clear bees with Thunder or Magnet. Final Mix allows five minutes to finish, but the Journal target remains 90 seconds.

kh2fm.minigames.the-hunny-pot.appendInstructions: Talk to Pooh. Trigger Swing near full power, then Release toward open ground. In Final Mix Release becomes available after one and a half rotations; the filling gauge resets immediately at maximum.

kh2fm.minigames.gift-wrapping.appendInstructions: Talk to the elf after the story activity. Fill large boxes quickly, reload the 30-toy magazine, and stun Lock, Shock and Barrel before they knock boxes away.

kh2fm.minigames.sb-workshop-rave.appendInstructions: Talk to Lock. Score at least 1,000 within 30 seconds in one attempt.

kh2fm.minigames.sb-time-attack.appendInstructions: Talk to Will Turner. Collect all 23 crystals within 40 seconds.

kh2fm.minigames.light-cycle.appendInstructions: Replay through the computer terminal after the story course. Use the attack that counters each enemy action, and watch the directional turn prompts.

recipeMenuReconciliation.limitations: Randomizer input template, not a personal retail extraction. Serenity modifiers corroborated from item/FM tables; they are not explicit MIRE fields.

summonProgressionEvidence.sharedExperienceUnit: One EXP whenever the Summon Gauge drops by a whole bar
summonProgressionEvidence.boundary: The full curve is corroborated by the explicitly named Final Mix fixture in OpenKH, parsed with its FormFm enum; this is source-derived repository evidence, not a fresh retail extraction. PC ReFined code separately confirms caps 2+owned charms with 6 promoted to 7. Original-release guides are supplementary, not the basis for edition parity.

finalMixFixture.format: BaseTable header version 2, 45 eight-byte rows; <BBHi; form ID high nibble, level low nibble; FormFm.Summon=0. EXP values are per-level requirements.

additionalBattleEvidence.scope: All five Absent Silhouettes and thirteen KHII Final Mix Data rematches; each Game page KHII/Final Mix strategy sections read, KHIII sections excluded. Controller-neutral approaches are practical strategies, not minimum-stat or guaranteed-win claims.

sourceResolutions.decision: Retain Mythril Shard. KHGuides current table labels both #6 and #7 Blazing Shard; rejected #7 reward only, retaining independently checked landmark. KH Wiki explicit FM table and Gamer Guides 2.5 numbered walkthrough identify #7 Mythril Shard; pinned randomizer names chest248 CourtyardMythrilShard2 and chest247 CourtyardBlazingShard.
